findings.title: Correct the grant-type comparison in the token ID matcher
findings.body: The grant shortcut occupies indices 4 through 5, but this matcher reads substring(3, 5). It also rejects equality rather than inequality. Consequently, an ID such as `onrtna:<UUID>` passes an authorization-code expectation, so the integration assertions do not detect missing or incorrect grant metadata. Validate the prefix length, read substring(4, 6), and reject a shortcut that differs from the expected value.

findings.title: Specify the two-character requirement for grant shortcuts
findings.body: The SPI documents shortcuts as normally three letters, but the default decoder requires a six-character context containing exactly two characters per field. A custom grant following this documentation and returning `abc` produces IDs such as `onrtabc:<UUID>`, which the same provider rejects during decoding. Document the exact two-character requirement and validate it when registering grant factories, or make the encoding accommodate the documented lengths.

findings.title: Avoid passing the invalid-grant test on an uninitialized factory
findings.body: The test setup never calls postInit or supplies a sessionFactory. Because `ac` is absent from its shortcut map, decoding invokes the factory's provider-discovery fallback and throws NullPointerException before reaching the decoder's unknown-grant validation. Catching any RuntimeException treats that setup failure as success, so the intended validation remains untested. Supply a factory that returns an empty provider stream and assert the expected IllegalArgumentException.

findings.title: Validate rawTokenId instead of checking grantType twice
findings.body: The final null guard checks grantType again rather than rawTokenId. A context with a null raw identifier is therefore accepted, and encodeTokenId converts it into a literal identifier such as `onrtro:null`. Multiple such contexts produce identical token IDs instead of rejecting the missing identifier. Apply this requireNonNull check to rawTokenId.
